# TAP public API provenance

`tap-windows.h` is the unmodified public header from OpenVPN tap-windows6
9.27.0 `dist.win10.zip`, `dist.win10/include/tap-windows.h`.
SHA256: `FEB886F22C393DFEEE51B214C20C732429250CA60FB64E029ABAD41D2209D038`.

Upstream explicitly offers this header under GPLv2 **or MIT**. This PoC uses
the MIT option; preserve `COPYRIGHT.MIT` and the header notices.
`TAP-COPYING.txt` records upstream's distinction between this header and the
GPLv2 driver. The driver is not built, modified, or included here.

Driver package, Wintun binaries and GPL driver reference sources downloaded
for research remain under ignored `out/tap-research/`; their licenses are
separate. No project-wide license is changed by this notice.
